FG Machines RCK · MTTL family · Local-first controller

FG Machines RCK is an independent local controller for compatible LG U+ / TONLY smart power strips. It is not an official LG U+ application. The project prioritizes local Wi‑Fi operation, clear diagnostics and safe relay control.

Primary verified family: MTTL-W01. Known certificate revisions include HU04139-17002A/B/C/D/E. Setup signatures TONLY_TAP_* and ONLY_TAP_* are recognized, with protocol verification before relay controls are enabled.
Best option. Connect this phone to the 2.4 GHz router and save its IPv4, then join TONLY_TAP and write the router credentials. After provisioning, reconnect this phone to the same router.
Best option without a router. Phone A keeps a 2.4 GHz hotspot running with FG Machines RCK listening. Phone B joins TONLY_TAP and writes Phone A hotspot credentials and controller IPv4.
Uses the same phone for setup and hotspot. Some Android phones shut Wi‑Fi down when hotspot starts, so use this only on compatible devices.
Settings written. Reconnect this phone to the target router Wi‑Fi. FG Machines RCK will wait for the strip on TCP 10086.
Settings written. Keep Phone A hotspot running and return to Phone A. The strip should join that hotspot and connect to FG Machines RCK.
Settings written. Turn the same 2.4 GHz hotspot back on now and wait for the strip to connect to FG Machines RCK.
